title: Cobb Salad
description: Crisp romaine topped with rows of chicken, bacon, hard-boiled egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese, with a red wine vinaigrette.

image.alt: A cobb salad with rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs: cover them with cold water in the saucepan, bring to a boil, turn off the heat, cover and leave for {time 11 min}. Cool in cold water, peel and quarter.
Cook the bacon in the skillet over medium heat until crisp, {time 8-10 min}. Drain on paper towels, then crumble. Pour off the fat.

Season the chicken with the salt. Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden and it reads {temp 165F internal} in the thickest part, {time 5-6 min} per side. Rest for {time 5 min}, then dice.
Shake the dressing ingredients together in a jar until blended.
Spread the romaine on a large platter. Arrange the chicken, bacon, eggs, tomatoes, avocado and blue cheese over it in rows. Drizzle with dressing just before serving, or serve it on the side.

notes: Leftover roast or rotisserie chicken makes this much quicker; you’ll need about 3 cups diced.
Store the components separately and the salad keeps for 2 days; dress just before eating.
